title: Daily Dose #400: Keep Yourselves in God’s Love
body:
**“Keep yourselves in the love of God, waiting for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ.”**

Jude writes to Christians surrounded by false teaching and moral compromise. His answer is not panic. He tells them to build themselves up in the faith, pray in the Holy Spirit and remain in the love of God.

This does not mean earning God’s love through perfect behaviour. It means staying where His love is known, trusted and obeyed rather than wandering into teachings that separate grace from truth.

We remain through ordinary means: Scripture, prayer, fellowship, repentance and patient hope in Jesus. Neglect creates drift. No one plans to become spiritually cold; attention simply moves elsewhere a little at a time.

If you have drifted, return. You do not need to wait until you feel more spiritual. Open the Word. Speak honestly to God. Ask a mature believer for help. Turn from the compromise you have been protecting.

Keep close to the truth of Christ and wait for His mercy.
